topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I opened the box, its contents familiar yet distant, like memories from another life. Each item, a keepsake from a time I couldn’t quite place. A photograph, faded and crinkled, of faces smiling under a sky I don’t recall. A letter, my handwriting unmistakable, speaking of dreams that now feel more like whispers. A coin, old and warm, as if just passed through many hands. I closed the lid gently, wondering about the hands that buried it and those that dug it up, hoping they found what they sought. The garden, where I found it, was still quiet, the air around me holding the secrets of the soil.
